purpose: Candidate retrieval, scoped feature lookup, and concept-graph membership. LLM review decides identity and applicability.

features.label: No additional span restriction explicitly imposed

bindings.source_value: Only deterministic strategies are allowed. Queries, stopping and postprocessing may be arbitrary measurable adaptive functions of the history. No linear-span or zero-respecting restriction is imposed.

Private randomization is allowed, with the seed independent of the instance and external randomness. Queries, stopping and postprocessing may be arbitrary measurable adaptive functions of the history. No linear-span or zero-respecting restriction is imposed.

Return $\widehat{x}\in X$. The output may be an unqueried point, an average or convex combination that remains in the stated space. No function value, gradient, inner solution, or accuracy certificate must accompany the output.

domains.description: A given compact domain X contained in R^d; the RKHS in G02/G05 is the restriction of the public kernel to X.
X is the optimization domain itself; no additional localization of an unconstrained global minimizer is promised.
